effects.label: Automatic
effects.description: Follows the state: breathe when idle, chase while working.

parameters.name: mapping_source
parameters.description: Choose the current state map or a Scene-specific map.

effects.label: Breathe
effects.description: One slow swell, every LED together.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.description: Relative distance between the luminous floor and crest.

effects.label: Ember
effects.description: Coals glowing: the middle burns hottest, the rim barely smoulders, all as one slow swell. Shared strips ride it as a unison swell over a warm bed.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: bed
parameters.description: Relative luminance the coals never sink below.

effects.label: Duotone
effects.description: A slow swell that alternates between two tones of the color. Cycle turns keep both tones; interleaved strips breathe.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: secondary_hue_offset_degrees
parameters.description: How far round the colour wheel the second tone sits, when no palette is set.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: The two colours it moves between; leave it empty to take both from the session's colour.

effects.label: Chase
effects.description: The same swell, staggered into a travelling wave.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction of travel.

parameters.name: crests
parameters.description: How many waves travel the strip at once.

parameters.name: softness
parameters.description: How gently the wave's tail fades: 0 is a comet's short tail, 1 a long soft one.

effects.label: Gradient
effects.description: The travelling wave, but each LED carries its own shade of the color — a gradient rolling by. Shared strips keep the flare; Cycle turns keep the shades.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction of gradient travel.

parameters.name: hue_span_degrees
parameters.description: Derived palette span when no explicit endpoints are supplied.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: The gradient's two end colours; leave it empty to take them from the session's colour.

effects.label: Heartbeat
effects.description: Two quick swells, then a long rest — a lub-dub.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: rest_ratio
parameters.description: Fraction of the cycle that rests after the two beats.

effects.label: Scanner
effects.description: A bright dot sweeps end to end and bounces back. Shared strips ride it as a narrow travelling flare.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: beam_width
parameters.description: Width of the bright scanning beam in LEDs.

parameters.name: trail
parameters.description: Relative length of the fading trail.

effects.label: Knight Rider
effects.description: The classic scanner: a wide bright eye sweeps end to end and back, overlapping as it goes. Shared strips ride it as a narrow travelling flare.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: beam_width
parameters.description: Width of the overlapping mechanical eye.

parameters.name: overlap
parameters.description: Overlap between the eye's light bands.

effects.label: Pendulum
effects.description: A weight on a string: the light hangs at each end and rushes, dimmer, through the middle. Shared strips ride it as a narrow travelling flare.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: glow
parameters.description: How wide the swinging light's glow is, in LEDs.

effects.label: Comet
effects.description: A bright head sweeps one way, trailing off behind. Shared strips ride it as a narrow travelling flare.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: head_width
parameters.description: Width of the bright comet head in LEDs.

parameters.name: trail_length
parameters.description: Length of the fading trail in LEDs.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction of comet travel.

parameters.name: pass_mode
parameters.description: Continuous loop or a bounded transition pass count.

effects.label: Glint
effects.description: One thin bright pass sweeping a lit strip, like light catching a rim. Shared strips ride it as a narrow flare over a lit bed.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: bed
parameters.description: Relative luminance the strip holds while the glint passes.

effects.label: Flicker
effects.description: A warm candle-like shimmer that never quite repeats.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Picks one of many repeatable flicker patterns.

parameters.name: luminance_floor
parameters.description: Lowest relative luminance.

parameters.name: variation
parameters.description: How far the brightness wanders as it flickers.

effects.label: Stack
effects.description: LEDs pile on one by one until full, then it all lets go. Keeps its hard pile-on in shared strips.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: fill_direction
parameters.description: Direction in which LEDs accumulate.

parameters.name: release_behavior
parameters.description: How a completed stack returns to its luminous floor.

effects.label: Twinkle
effects.description: A dim base with single LEDs briefly sparking, scattered.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Maximum fraction of LEDs sparkling at once.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Picks one of many repeatable sparkle patterns.

effects.label: Drift
effects.description: Glacial detuned swells, like light on slow water.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: detune
parameters.description: How far each LED's slow swell strays from the others.

effects.label: Converge
effects.description: Two dots leave the ends and meet in the middle. In a Split block the fronts meet mid-block.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: Convergence geometry used for merge or handoff meaning.

effects.label: Bloom
effects.description: Light opens from the center outward, holds lit, then fades — the lid-open signature as a loop. Shared strips ride it as the full swell.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: hold_ratio
parameters.description: Fraction of the cycle the open strip holds lit before it drains.

effects.label: Ripple
effects.description: A stone in water: the middle crests first and a wide ring runs outward, dimmer at every step, then the next stone falls. Shared strips ride it as a unison swell.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: fade
parameters.description: How much dimmer each ring is than the one inside it.

effects.label: Aurora
effects.description: Rolling waves of light over a luminous base.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Up to four colours; leave it empty to take tones from the session's colour.

parameters.name: wave_count
parameters.description: How many slow waves drift across the strip.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Picks one of many repeatable wave patterns.

effects.label: Tide
effects.description: The bar rises to full, then the water pulls back. Shared strips ride it as the full swell.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: How long one full cycle takes.

parameters.name: fill_floor
parameters.description: Minimum filled fraction before the tide rises.

parameters.name: fill_range
parameters.description: Additional filled fraction at full tide.
